page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.xlarge is a compute-focused instance powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base clock of 2.9 GHz. Operating under a KVM hypervisor, this virtual machine provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Cache resources include 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware integration excludes local storage and discrete GPUs, requiring external network-attached block storage for operating system and data persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent single-threaded execution balanced against throughput limitations inherent to a 4-vCPU envelope. The processor achieves average-tier scores in single-core stress-ng testing (1883.99) and Geekbench single-core testing (1556.0), accompanied by standard throughput in single-threaded gzip compression (27.97 GB/sec). Conversely, aggregate multi-threaded metrics fall into lower percentiles, registering 3871.28 in stress-ng multi-core and 3343.0 in Geekbench multi-core. Memory bandwidth tests yield 30.35 GB/sec for uncached read operations and 25.29 GB/sec for uncached write operations, aligning with PassMark memory test results in the lower quartile.

Workload testing highlights throughput ceilings across I/O-heavy and high-concurrency tasks, with Redis recording 3.95 million SET operations per second and static web serving reaching 6.33 GB/sec. Lightweight AI inference with a 135M parameter language model produces 406.43 prompt tokens per second and 107.65 text generation tokens per second. Given its compute-leaning memory profile and dedicated core allocation, the ecs.c7se.xlarge instance fits moderate computational tasks, batch processing, microservices, and continuous integration runners that do not require expansive memory footprints or bundled high-speed local disk storage.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7se.xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual server running on the Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.9 GHz under a KVM hypervisor. It offers 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core, combined with 8.0 GB of memory for a 1:2 core-to-memory distribution. Architectural features include 48 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 and cryptographic instruction support. The instance includes no local storage or discrete GPU hardware, relying on external network-attached volumes and offering a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. Performance benchmarks exhibit steady single-core computing power alongside reduced multi-core throughput, reflected in moderate single-threaded compression and Geekbench single-core figures alongside lower-tier multi-threaded and memory bandwidth metrics. The ecs.c7se.xlarge instance is suitable for intermediate computational workloads, application middleware, CI/CD worker nodes, and backend processing pipelines requiring dedicated CPU allocations without large RAM requirements.
